review:
A five-piece animal rock band on 25 lines. VIP concert tickets are the scatters, and three on reels 1, 3 and 5 give you eight free spins where all the low-paying symbols are gone – only premiums land, and retriggers are unlimited.

There's a second route too: six or more CD symbols start a separate disk bonus. Having two different bonuses keeps sessions varied, and those premium-only free spins can stack up big line wins. Medium-high volatility, 7,500x max and a strong 96.88% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
